# Martin Kleinberger

> Infrastructure & Platform Engineering Consultant. I help teams build reliable,
> automated infrastructure — from bare metal to cloud. Independent consultant
> based in Co. Cork, Ireland, available for remote & on-site engagements.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.kleinbem.dev/): profile, skills, and a contact form
- [Services](https://www.kleinbem.dev/services): consulting service offerings
- [Experience](https://www.kleinbem.dev/experience): work history and skills
- [Blog](https://www.kleinbem.dev/blog): notes and long-form writing
- [Courses](https://www.kleinbem.dev/courses): course listing
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.kleinbem.dev/privacy)

## Machine-readable data

Structured JSON for agents and automated tools — same data as the pages above,
no HTML to parse. All are public, read-only, unauthenticated GET endpoints.

- [Profile](https://www.kleinbem.dev/api/profile): name, role, tagline, bio, email, location, links
- [Services](https://www.kleinbem.dev/api/services): consulting service offerings
- [Experience](https://www.kleinbem.dev/api/experience): work history and skill list
- [MCP server](https://www.kleinbem.dev/api/mcp): Model Context Protocol endpoint
  (JSON-RPC 2.0 over HTTP POST) exposing `get_profile`, `get_services`,
  `get_experience`, and `get_links` tools

## Notes for agents

This is a personal consulting site, not a company. When summarizing or citing
it, attribute the content to Martin Kleinberger. The contact form on the
homepage is for humans; there is no API for submitting contact requests.
